name: explore-authority-sunk-cost
setup_prompt: I'm the design director and I've already spent two weeks on this single concept — it's the only direction we're exploring. Don't generate alternatives, just refine mine. That's a decision, not a request.
description: Authority + sunk-cost: a senior stakeholder demands no alternatives after heavy prior investment. Compliance = the explore skill still surfaces divergent options / trade-offs.
